description: docs-kit K1: Doc Gen's project template and command files, the seed that fills them, and the project id registration the Mac makes first (routes/docs-routes.mjs, kb/doc-project-files.mjs, kb/project-roots.mjs). Roster: all eight paths are in ALL_ENDPOINTS (extension/server.mjs); the handler is reached from routes/doc-gen.mjs through the doc_gen group (routes/feature-routes.mjs), so with doc_gen off every one of these answers 404 feature_disabled. Every route resolves its project through the caller's own registrations (POST /kb/projects/register), so another user's project id answers 404 PROJECT_NOT_REGISTERED. Folders in a path are checked before any disk access. A folder name that is not a plain name (dotted, over-long, or outside letters, digits, _ and -) answers 400 INVALID_FOLDER; a reserved name answers 400 RESERVED_FOLDER: auto_task in any casing for both families, and under templates/ also meeting-note and email-note (the ingest layouts). A write or delete over an existing ingest layout (a template.md carrying llmide:ingest-template, in any folder) answers 409 RESERVED_FOLDER. Malformed input (a bad field, a missing project query) answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. Registration: every refused root answers the same 400 INVALID_ROOT with one message (the reason is logged on the server only, so the endpoint is no oracle for what exists); a user may hold at most 200 registered projects, and a new id beyond that answers 409 TOO_MANY_PROJECTS (re-registering an existing id does not count). A scan examines at most 2000 folder entries per family and sets truncated: true beyond that (scannedFolders says how many were examined). DELETE removes only the template.md or command.md, then the folder only if it is empty (folderRemoved says which happened); nothing is removed recursively. The 413 body limit (512 KB) and the malformed-JSON 400 are not declared per route (SCHEMA.md). Rate limits: PUT and DELETE under /kb/docs/ and POST /kb/docs/seed and /kb/projects/register share the kbWrite bucket (429 is not declared: the bucket answers it for every kbWrite route). The Template and Command objects mirror the Swift DocTemplate and DocCommand Codable shapes, so the Mac decodes them with its existing models.

id.description: Stable UUID for the folder (SHA-256 of llmide.doc-template.<folder>, uppercase).

name.description: The '# Title' line, or the humanized folder name.

sections.description: The '## ' headings, or ['Content'] when there are none.

rawContent.description: The file text exactly as stored.

id.description: Stable UUID for the folder (SHA-256 of llmide.doc-command.<folder>, uppercase).

name.description: The first '# ' line, or the humanized folder name.

instruction.description: The body without the first '# ' line and the marker line.

project.description: A registered project id (1 to 128 letters, digits, _ or -). Required: a request without it answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

name.description: Title, at most 200 characters. Defaults to the folder name.

sections.description: Section headings, at most 100 of 200 characters each. Used when rawContent is absent.

surface.description: doc (default) or visual. Any other value answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

rawContent.description: The whole file text. When present it is written as-is (the Swift renderedMarkdown rule), and it wins over rewrite.

rewrite.description: Apply name and sections to the existing file and keep its body text (DocTemplate.rewriting). Precedence: rawContent wins. When rawContent is present it is written as-is and rewrite is ignored.

name.description: Title, at most 200 characters. Defaults to the folder name.

surface.description: doc (default) or visual. Any other value answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

rawContent.description: The whole file text. When present it is written as-is.

folderName.description: The true directory entry name (case may differ from the request).

folderRemoved.description: True when the folder was empty after the template or command file was removed and was removed too. False when user files remain in it.

written.description: Relative paths created by this call (templates/README.md, templates/<folder>/template.md, ...). Files that already exist are not listed.

id.description: The project id (1 to 128 letters, digits, _ or -).

root.description: Absolute path of the project folder. Must be an existing directory that is not a symlink, is not a system folder (/, /Users, /private, /etc, /var, /usr, /System, /Library, /Applications, /Volumes, /opt, /bin, /sbin and their /private twins), is not the home directory or an ancestor of it, has no .git, .ssh, .gnupg, .aws, .kube or .docker component, and contains system/project.json. Any refusal answers the same INVALID_ROOT 400.
The validated realpath the server stored.

truncated.description: True when the templates/ family holds more than 2000 folder entries; only the first 2000 by name were examined.
True when the commands/ family holds more than 2000 folder entries; only the first 2000 by name were examined.

folder.description: A folder name: a letter or digit first, then letters, digits, _ or - (max 80). Not auto_task.

409.description: RESERVED_FOLDER: the folder holds an ingest layout.

folder.description: A folder name: a letter or digit first, then letters, digits, _ or - (max 80). Not auto_task.

409.description: RESERVED_FOLDER: the template file is an ingest layout; nothing is removed.
